description: The best way to elect Democrats is to talk to voters about our candidates. Join our door knocking team now through November as we get out the vote for Odessa Kelly and Ronnie Glynn. You will be trained on our message and how to talk to votes. Bring a friend if you want to door knock as a team! RSVP
title: Door Knocking for Dems — Ronnie Glynn for State Rep
